senses.gloss: m. (עֶשֶׂר) one tenth; (= מַעֲשֵׂר) tithe, giving tithes.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 68a:16">Keth. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>ראשונה נוטלת ע׳ נכסים וכ׳</he> the first daughter gets one-tenth of the estate, the second one-tenth of what is left &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 2:6">Bicc. II, 6</cite> <he>בשעת לקיטתו עִשּׂוּרוֹ</he> the giving of tithes is regulated by the time it (the Ethrog) is plucked, expl. Y. ib. 65ᵃ bot. <he>בשעת לקיטתו עישורו למעשרות ולשביעית</he> this regulation refers to tithes as well as to the Sabbatical year (the time of plucking decides to which year the fruit belongs).
Maas. Sh. V, 9; a. fr.—Trnsf. dedication, sanctification.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:5">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:13">Deut. VII, 13</cite>) <he>מה פרי אדמתך צריכים ע׳ … צריכים ע׳ וכ׳</he> as the fruit of thy soil requires sanctification by tithes, so the fruit of thy womb requires sanctification, which is circumcision.—Pl. <he>עִישּׂוּרִים</he>, <he>עִישּׂוּרִין</he>, <cite ref="P00701"><he>עִשּׂ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 14a:11">R. Hash. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>נהג בו שני ע׳</he> he subjected it to two tithes (that of the second and that of the third year).
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 8:18">Tosef. Dem. VIII, 18</cite> <he>תשעים ושלשה חסר שני ע׳</he> ninety-three parts less two-tenths.

<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 8:15">Ib. 15</cite> <he>שתי תאנים ושני ע׳ ועִישּׂוּרוֹ של עישור</he> two figs (as Trumah), and two tithes (first and second), and tithe of the tithes (= <he>מעשר מן המעשר</he>); Y. ib. I, end, 22ᵇ <he>ועישורין של עישור</he> (corr. acc.).
